scope: Three predefined registered VAL windows (TRUMANS exo noisy, EgoBody master exo clean, RICH ego clean). Not full-corpus throughput.
prediction_protocol: same step4200, exact original noise seed, DDIM20, batch1, original observation/geometry/guidance configuration
timing: CUDA-synchronized complete sampling and separately scene metrics; current VAL runs concurrently; components are inclusive

scene.observation_budget: entire supplied recording observed-static union; same observer/world/split only; dynamics current frame
scene.coordinate_protocol: persistent world map; transform to current window anchor at query
scene.evaluation_input_scope: supplied recording only; restricted benchmark clips must use a restricted observation manifest

feedback.position_protocol: root translation and SO3 FK, fixed bone lengths

config.training_status: v4 modules wired; warm source is selected explicitly in pilot metadata, no full training before scene gate

validation.scope: fixed windows; original unweighted GT; no test tuning

config.exo_window_policy: at least one observed joint; maximum 18 consecutive all-joint-missing raw30 frames; partial joint occlusion retained; full static recording memory unchanged

reference_input.coordinate_frame: same fixed window world coordinates as scene and observed tracks
reference_input.fallback: observed-track kinematic initializer with supplied rest bones; no GT motion
reference_input.occluded_prior: retain full estimated motion; encode low position/rotation confidence
reference_input.availability: real video frontend predictions are not yet in current dataset cache

refinement.placement: predicted proposal and final x0 within diffusion
refinement.exo: confidence/uncertainty weighted observed torso rigid pose
refinement.ego: head position translation only; no camera-to-body heading constraint
refinement.joint_anchor_schedule: cosine alpha; skip alpha<0.05; predicted proposal and final x0; root excluded

scene_relations.input_policy: predicted body and trusted tracks only; broad upward samples are context, not completed surfaces

physical_guidance.acceptance: joint physical/observation/prior energy decreases and trusted measurements protected
physical_guidance.placement: every clean x0 before next DDIM update; shallow observed support only
